subject.title: Create example OpenClaw plugin using before_install

question: Should ClawScan own a repo-hosted OpenClaw `before_install` example plugin, or should the example remain an external OpenClaw plugin package until the boundary is clearer?
rationale: The requested work is useful for install-time security scanning, but it adds plugin/package/configuration surface around OpenClaw policy and current project guidance keeps ClawScan CLI-first unless maintainers sponsor the expansion.

options.title: Keep external first
options.body: Publish or preserve the plugin as a separate OpenClaw package and revisit repo inclusion after maintainers confirm ClawScan should own this example surface.

options.title: Sponsor a repo-hosted example
options.body: Approve a narrow PR that adds only the plugin package, tests, local proof, and docs without expanding public ClawScan CLI flags or README roadmap claims.

options.title: Close after linked publication
options.body: If the example is published elsewhere and no ClawScan code or docs change remains, close this issue with a link to that package.

recommendation.title: Keep external first
recommendation.body: Publish or preserve the plugin as a separate OpenClaw package and revisit repo inclusion after maintainers confirm ClawScan should own this example surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the default code owner and owns the issue plus the off-main plugin history.
